IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Technology & Communications (originally sponsored by Senators Honeyford, B. Sheldon and Johnson)

Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the taxation of telephone services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bundled telecommunications services; and addinga new section to chapter 82.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a taxing jurisdiction does not subject some charges fortelephone services to taxation, but these charges are aggregated withand not separately stated from charges that are subject to taxation,then the charges for nontaxable telephone services may be subject totaxation unless the telephone service or provider can reasonablyidentify charges not subject to the tax, charge, or fee from its booksand records that are kept in the regular course of business and forpurposes other than merely allocating the sales price of an aggregatedcharge to the individually aggregated items.
